annotations.title: Attach a receipt to a payment

description:
Attach a stored receipt to the payment the member picked from `well_list_receipt_candidates`. Well records the pick as a confirmed match, decided by a person, and puts the receipt on that payment. A later automatic match never replaces it.

Call it only after the member answered the numbered list with the number of a payment, with the `document_id` of that list and the picked payment's `transaction_id`. The member's answer is the consent: do not ask again. Never call it on your own guess, and never for the last choice (none of them).

Read `outcome`:
- `linked`: confirm in one line with the payment's date, payee (`transaction.label`) and amount (for example « Reçu rattaché au paiement du 03/10 (Le Comptoir, 42,50 €). »). `transaction.amount` is signed: an outflow is negative. Say it without the minus sign.
- `already_linked`: the receipt was already on this payment; say so.
- `ask_document_kind`: Well read no receipt or invoice in this document; ask what it is (a receipt, a supplier invoice, or something else).
- `refused`: nothing was written. `reason` says why: `transaction_not_found` (no such payment here), `transaction_has_other_document` (that payment already holds another document, which Well never replaces), `over_allocated` (the receipt or the payment is already settled), `invalid` (Well cannot match this pair), `settled_by_other_invoice` (another invoice already settles that payment), `wrong_direction` (that payment moves the wrong way for this receipt), `not_offered` (that payment is not one the list offers for this receipt now: offer the list again), `receipt_linked_elsewhere` (the receipt already sits on another payment: say it is already attached to a payment, and do not offer the list again), `document_not_read` (Well is still reading the document: say you will try again in a moment). Tell the member in one line. Offer the list again for every reason except `receipt_linked_elsewhere` and `document_not_read`.

It writes only inside Well.

conversation_id.description: The conversation id returned by the previous Well result, in its meta under well/conversation_id, in its structuredContent, or in its JSON text block. Pass it back on every call in the same conversation, including a call a card makes, so the chosen workspace and the earlier answers still apply. It decides the conversation on its own: nothing the host states about the session replaces it. Omit it only on the first call of a conversation.

document_id.description: The stored document of the receipt, as `well_list_receipt_candidates` read it.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A retried write with the same key returns the original result instead of re-applying the operation.

transaction_id.description: The payment the member picked by its number.

workspace_id.description: Target workspace. Omit when the token authorizes one workspace. Required when it authorizes several — a write lands in exactly one workspace and this call would not say which.

name: well_link_receipt_to_transaction

conversation_id.description: The conversation this result belongs to. Pass it back as the conversation_id argument on every later Well call in the same conversation.

conversation_id_note.description: Present only when the server opened a fresh lane, stating that no choice recorded earlier was read.

conversation_id_source.description: Where the conversation id came from: the host's own request meta, the caller's argument, or a fresh lane the server opened.
